news.title: Maple Planner and boss checks
news.text: The planner works: it remembers your checks, and Start / Complete handle your dailies. Move to Boss and the Contents Guide show a check on bosses you've cleared. Thanks to Twoal from the Discord.

news.title: Story Skip
news.text: Always available now, and it works for every class.

news.title: Erel Light
news.text: Can be created again. More fixes coming, it's not fully playable yet.

news.title: Bosses
news.text: Lotus, Princess No, Damien, Lucid and Ursus fixes. Princess No drops match GMS. Practice Mode works.

news.title: Classes
news.text: Fixes for Adele, Hero, Night Walker, Wild Hunter, Mihile, Zero, Kaiser, Cadena, Ren, Luminous and more.

news.title: Enhancing
news.text: The Scroll tab doesn't freeze anymore, every item has GMS's extra upgrade slot, and Star Force gets the old Star Catching bonus.

news.title: Surprise Style Boxes
news.text: Open again from the Cash Inventory and the Cash Shop, Use 1 and Use All both work.

news.title: Other players
news.text: No more floating when someone enters the map, and guild names are readable again.

news.title: New launcher on the way
news.text: One window for playing and, for admins, running the server.
